svg.title: IX. The Hermit: sprint.nvim
svg.desc: IX. The Hermit, upright. Neovim Plugins. Robust command runner for Neovim.. Artwork from scanned Gustave Doré Inferno engravings, first published in 1861.

g.desc: Gustave Doré, Inferno (1861), Farinata addresses Dante. https://archive.org/details/dantesinferno00dantuoft; scan leaf 139. Public domain: nineteenth-century engravings; Doré died in 1883. The digitizing collection records NOT_IN_COPYRIGHT.
